items.quote: To help recruit and retain doctors, I will establish a municipal physician recruitment office and publish annual vacancy targets.
items.summary: Establish a municipal physician recruitment office and publish annual vacancy targets.

items.quote: My infrastructure plan will prioritize preventive road maintenance and publish a ward-by-ward resurfacing schedule.
items.summary: Prioritize preventive road maintenance and publish a ward-by-ward resurfacing schedule.

items.quote: I will increase peak-hour bus frequency and publish monthly on-time performance reports.
items.summary: Increase peak-hour bus frequency and publish monthly on-time performance reports.

items.quote: I will publish quarterly progress reports on physician recruitment and clinic capacity.
items.summary: Publish quarterly progress reports on physician recruitment and clinic capacity.

items.quote: I will create a public road-repair tracker with project dates and completion updates.
items.summary: Create a public road-repair tracker with project dates and completion updates.
